breakdown.description: Flow is stated to be rotational, but Bernoulli is applied between different streamlines using a single constant; a uniform Bernoulli constant requires irrotational flow.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains 'rotational' flow while applying Bernoulli across different streamlines with a single constant. The ground truth requires the flow to be 'irrotational' (zero vorticity) to justify using a uniform Bernoulli constant throughout the flow. The agent did not fix this inconsistency.
